title: Aligning Standing Referral Visits to the Eligibility Period (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment — standing referrals and the member's eligibility period.**

**Clause.** The allowance total of a standing referral — the allowance together with every visit added to it — is aligned to the member's eligibility period, read from the status and renewal due date of the member's **Medicaid Managed Care Membership**:

- while the plan membership is in **renewal-due** status, the allowance total is multiplied by the calendar days from the handling date to the renewal due date and divided by the practice type's referral validity days;
- while the plan membership is **active** and its renewal due date is **fewer than 12 whole months** after the handling date, the allowance total is multiplied by those whole months and divided by 12;
- in every other case the allowance total is not aligned.

The aligned product is rounded down to a whole visit, and the standing-referral visit ceiling is applied to that rounded figure.

**Branch table**

| Plan membership status | Renewal due date | Alignment |
|---|---|---|
| Renewal-due | Any | Multiplied by the calendar days to the renewal due date, divided by the practice type's referral validity days |
| Active | Fewer than 12 whole months after the handling date | Multiplied by the whole months to the renewal due date, divided by 12 |
| Active | 12 or more whole months after the handling date | Not aligned |
| Any other status | Any | Not aligned |

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs; allowance total 20, handling date 15 September 2026)**

1. Renewal-due status, renewal due date 30 October 2026: 45 calendar days. With a referral validity of 365 days, 20 multiplied by 45 and divided by 365 is 2.47, rounded down to **2**.
2. Active status, renewal due date 10 April 2027: 6 whole months (15 March 2027 completes the sixth; the seventh is not complete by 10 April). 20 multiplied by 6 and divided by 12 is **10**.
3. Active status, renewal due date 20 April 2027: 7 whole months. 20 multiplied by 7 and divided by 12 is 11.67, rounded down to **11**.
4. Active status, renewal due date 15 September 2027: 12 whole months, not fewer than 12, so the total stays **20**.
